name: gouache_cut
description: gouache: the set's bands as broad flat shapes in teal, navy and mint, their edges dragged ragged by a dry brush, with a few lime strokes where it caught
notes: From wallhaven-4omjp5 (item 061). Seven flat sheets of the smooth count, each one of the map's flat paints (`hop` 0.125), their edges torn by the pass's `ragged` member: each sample takes the sheet of a sample up to `reach` 0.035 of the frame away along a stroke at 50 degrees, every bristle (`width` 0.004) its own distance, so an edge frays into parallel tongues the way a dry brush leaves it; the `accent` paints 12% of the strokes the map's lime where they moved an edge. A thin `shadow` (0.006) sits the shapes on each other. The set's own edge is never dragged, so the lace stays whole. Its three looks (paper_layers, poster_curls, gouache_cut) are one palette layer and one `paper` pass, told apart by which of the pass's members they set.

The brush first pushed each sample's level by noise, in sheets: where the count climbs slowly an edge then moved half the frame and the picture was rain. Dragging in frame widths bounds it. Round one's readings: g_long (`reach` 0.07, `length` 0.3: longer, wilder strokes), g_clean (no brush: the flat shapes alone) and g_fine (bristles 0.0015; drafted, not in the picker). Sheets cut from `tia` or `curvature` under the brush are noise.
The first map's three dark paints missed the near-black share at four seats of six (0.27 against 0.204); the midnight was lifted and all six hold.
